title: Reversal of a Payment Protection Monthly Benefit
content:
A Payment Protection monthly benefit is reversed when it was paid for a coverage month in which the covered person had already returned to work or was no longer disabled, as shown by the proof of continued eligibility or by the employer or physician. A benefit is reversed at most once, and only a benefit actually paid can be reversed. The loan payment the benefit funded is returned with it, so the installment it covered becomes owed by the borrower again under the loan's normal rules; a returned benefit never carries a returned-payment fee. A death benefit is never reversed.

## Condition and result

| Situation of the benefit | Reversal |
|---|---|
| Monthly benefit paid for a month in which the covered person had already returned to work, shown by the proof of continued eligibility or by the employer | Reversed |
| Monthly benefit paid for a month in which the covered person was no longer disabled, shown by the proof of continued eligibility or by the physician | Reversed |
| Benefit that already has a reversal recorded against it | Not reversed again |
| Benefit that was never actually paid | Cannot be reversed |
| Death benefit | Never reversed |

## Effect of a reversal

- The reversal is recorded as its own line naming the benefit it reverses, the claim, the reversal date and the amount, and it reduces the plan's benefits-paid balance.
- The loan payment that the benefit funded is returned. The installment that payment covered becomes owed by the borrower again, under the loan's normal rules.
- No returned-payment fee is charged because a benefit was returned.
- A reversed month no longer counts as a benefit month paid on the claim.

## Basis questions

- **Which evidence shows that the covered person no longer qualified for the month?** The proof of continued eligibility, or the employer or the physician.
- **Can the same monthly benefit be reversed twice?** No. A benefit is reversed at most once; the plan's records show whether a reversal already names it.
- **Is a death benefit ever taken back?** No. A death benefit is never reversed.
